• Du beherrschst mindestens eine Ebene richtig tief, ob Kernel, Storage, Netzwerk oder Container-Runtime. Die übrigen verstehst du gut genug, um Wechselwirkungen zu erkennen. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut.

• Eigene Operatoren und Plattform-Services: Statt gemanagte Cloud-Dienste zusammenzustecken, entwickeln wir unsere Kubernetes-Controller, APIs und die Integration in Storage und Netzwerk (CNI, BGP) selbst.

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE
You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.
Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.
We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Risk and Controls Manager to join our Risk & Controls team, part of Pleo's Second Line of Defence. You'll report to our Head of Risk and Controls, helping build and run our enterprise risk management framework, from risk appetite linkage through to the risk reporting our senior leaders and committees rely on. Alongside that full ERM remit, you'll own second line oversight of security, technology and operational resilience risk, giving our technology and security teams informed, credible challenge. It's a rare mix: a broad enterprise risk role with a technology risk specialism, in a FinTech that's still shaping how it manages risk as it scales. We value people from a range of risk backgrounds, so if you match most of what's below, we'd love to hear from you.

WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You'll work closely with other members in our Risk and Controls team, the security GRC team in the First Line, as well as teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and Compliance.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Risk Manager, you will:

- Build and run our ERM framework: Work closely the Head of Risk and Control on our enterprise risk management framework, including risk appetite, how it links to our risks and controls, and the reporting that goes to senior management and governance committees.

- Own technology and security risk oversight: Lead 2LOD oversight of information security, technology and operational resilience risk, setting the methodology and standards and challenging the First Line on where the gaps are.

- Test our IT general controls: Run ITGC testing with our technology and security teams, assessing whether controls are well designed and working in practice.

- Lead high-risk testing when incidents happen: Partner with our Assurance & Controls Manager to lead incident-driven testing in our highest-risk areas and turn findings into clear actions.

- Run risk assessments and RCSAs: Lead risk assessments and risk and control self-assessments across the business, not just in technology.

- Shape our GRC tooling: Run GRC tools and help decide how we bring more structure and automation to how we manage risk.

- Be a trusted risk partner: Advise First Line teams on risk, regulatory change and the control environment, and support our engagement with regulators.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility)

WHAT YOU WILL DO
The Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility) coordinates the integration of privacy, legal, GEO and accessibility requirements across Amgen’s global web experiences. The role translates approved standards and expert guidance into practical requirements, reusable capabilities, risk-based readiness practices, and ongoing monitoring throughout the digital lifecycle. It partners with Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility, business, and technology teams; formal legal interpretations and policy decisions remain with the appropriate subject matter owners.

Key Responsibilities:

•
Privacy, Legal, GEO and Accessibility Standards: Coordinate the application of global privacy regulations, consent requirements, GEO playbook, accessibility standards, legal content, disclosures, and data collection and retention policies across digital properties and markets.

•
Requirements across the Lifecycle: Work with business, design, and technology teams to incorporate privacy, legal, GEO and accessibility requirements into strategy, experience design, requirements, development acceptance criteria, platform components, templates, and forms.

•
Consent, Data, and Third-Party Governance: Support cookie and tracker governance, consent and preference experiences, data minimization, transparent collection and use, retention requirements, vendor privacy compliance, and data-processing obligations.

•
Risk-Based Readiness and Remediation: Coordinate practical, risk-based readiness reviews across web experiences. Identify gaps and affected markets or properties, document accountable owners and timelines, and track remediation without treating governance as a final approval checkpoint.

•
Monitoring, Audit, and Regulatory Change: Support compliance and consent monitoring, audit evidence, regulatory change management, issue escalation, and remediation in partnership with Privacy, Legal, Accessibility, and technology stakeholders.

•
Lifecycle Controls and Measures: Coordinate privacy and legal controls through ongoing changes and retirement, including data retention or deletion, tracker removal, vendor termination, and regulatory records. Track compliance health, exceptions, remediation aging, privacy incidents, and consent effectiveness.

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU
